data.body: **[P1] Drain without occupying the worker needed by queued operations.** With `withExecutorService(Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor())`, a handler that starts `ctx.stepAsync(...)` and returns now deadlocks: the root task holds the only worker while draining waits for the queued step. Previously, the root task released that worker before the caller drained operations in `close()`. Arrange draining without consuming executor capacity needed by queued operations, while preserving lifecycle-hook ordering. Add a single-thread, unawaited-step regression test; the new two-thread test misses this case.
